# Phase 2: Walk Session & Geolocation Tracking - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-10-08
**Status:** Ready for planning

<domain>
## Phase Boundary

Phase 2 delivers the outdoor walk tracking engine with resilient session recovery, GPS jitter suppression, and interactive MapLibre trail mapping. Key deliverables include the `/walk` interface with active walk lifecycle management (Start, Auto-resume, Hold-to-End), foreground Geolocation tracking with noise filtering (rejecting accuracy > 35m, suppressing stationary jitter), OpenFreeMap Liberty style vector rendering with user location beacon and terracotta trail polyline, and a completion summary drawer displaying duration, distance, and confirmed species metrics.

</domain>

<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Walk Session UI & HUD Layout
- **D-01:** Full-screen MapLibre viewport with floating glassmorphism HUD pills (MM:SS timer, meters/km distance counter, GPS signal status chip) and bottom floating action dock with Tangerin Dream styling. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-02:** Live metrics displayed in top HUD: elapsed duration (MM:SS), distance in meters/km, and GPS signal status chip (e.g. Live / Searching / Weak). — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-03:** Pre-walk state on `/walk` displays live interactive map centered on current location with a floating bottom card containing "Start Walk" button and walk mode badge. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-04:** Auto-resumed walk sessions (upon tab reload or return from background) seamlessly restore tracking state with a brief toast notification ("Active walk resumed") and camera fly-to latest GPS fix. — **Reversibility:** reversible

### GPS Jitter & Weak Signal UX
- **D-05:** Subtle amber status chip in HUD ("Weak GPS ±Xm") when accuracy degrades beyond 35m, quietly pausing breadcrumb recording until accuracy improves to prevent noisy jumps. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-06:** Stationary stops (observing wildlife/photos) do not append duplicate jitter points to the trail polyline; system maintains last known coordinates and updates active walk timestamp. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-07:** Resuming from background throttling connects the gap continuously to the newly acquired GPS fix and updates cumulative distance via Haversine formula calculation. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-08:** GPS permission revocation or loss mid-walk keeps session active, showing an actionable top alert with "Re-enable Location" trigger and preserving all prior track points safely. — **Reversibility:** reversible

### Map Camera & Trail Navigation
- **D-09:** Camera auto-follows user location marker by default; user panning/dragging pauses follow-mode and displays a floating "Recenter" button to re-engage tracking. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-10:** Current location marker styled with Tangerin Dream terracotta/orange dot, subtle pulsing beacon ring, and heading arrow if device orientation is available. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-11:** Breadcrumb trail rendered as a terracotta brand color polyline (4px width, rounded joints) accompanied by a subtle "Approximate path" micro-legend pill in the map corner. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-12:** Floating thumb-accessible control stack positioned on the right edge: Recenter button, Zoom +/- buttons, and North compass reset. — **Reversibility:** reversible

### End Walk Flow & Summary Modal
- **D-13:** Hold-to-confirm button or 2-tap confirmation sheet guards against accidental walk termination while outdoors. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-14:** Walk summary presented as a bottom drawer / modal sheet over the map with bounding-box fitted trail review and metrics grid (duration, distance, confirmed species count placeholder). — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-15:** Short/empty walks (< 1 minute or < 25 meters) prompt "Discard Walk" vs "Save Anyway" to prevent cluttering Dexie walk history. — **Reversibility:** reversible
- **D-16:** Primary "Done" action on summary card closes the sheet and resets `/walk` back to the pre-walk ready state, with a secondary link to "View in Journal". — **Reversibility:** reversible

### the agent's Discretion
- Mathematical Kalman / rolling average smoothing parameters for heading calculation.
- Exact styling details for the glassmorphism backdrop-blur and border highlights in HUD pills.
- Bounding-box padding coordinates when fitting completed trail in the summary drawer.

</decisions>

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Full-screen Map with floating glassmorphism HUD | Full-screen Map with floating glassmorphism HUD pills (timer, distance) and bottom action bar (End Walk, capture trigger) — max outdoor readability | ✓ |
| Split view | Split view with top half map and bottom half stats card / control panel — structured traditional layout | |
| You decide | Implement best mobile-first layout following Tangerin Dream tokens | |

**User's choice:** Full-screen Map with floating glassmorphism HUD pills (timer, distance) and bottom action bar
**Notes:** Maximizes map screen real estate and spatial immersion while walking outdoors.

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Elapsed duration, distance, and GPS signal status | Elapsed duration (MM:SS), distance in meters/km, and GPS signal status chip (e.g., Live / Searching) | ✓ |
| Minimalist | Minimalist duration and distance only — zero extra indicators | |
| Expanded stats | Duration, distance, walking pace (min/km), and species count pill | |
| You decide | Flexible metrics selection | |

**User's choice:** Elapsed duration (MM:SS), distance in meters/km, and GPS signal status chip
**Notes:** Provides vital live feedback on tracking quality without overwhelming the outdoor interface.

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Interactive map with floating 'Start Walk' card | Interactive map centered on current location with floating bottom card: 'Start Walk' button and walk mode badge | ✓ |
| Resource-saver view | Clean pre-walk card prompting 'Start Walk'; MapLibre initializes only when walk begins | |
| You decide | Pre-walk landing experience | |

**User's choice:** Interactive map centered on current location with floating bottom card: 'Start Walk' button and walk mode badge
**Notes:** Pre-initializes the map and GPS fix so starting the walk is seamless and immediate.

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Seamless auto-restoration with toast | Seamless automatic restoration with a brief toast ('Active walk resumed') and camera fly-to current point | ✓ |
| Session recovery banner | Session recovery banner at the top with walk start timestamp and explicit 'Resume' confirmation | |
| Silent instant resume | Silent instant resume with zero notification | |
| You decide | Auto-resume notification approach | |

**User's choice:** Seamless automatic restoration with a brief toast ('Active walk resumed') and camera fly-to current point
**Notes:** Unobtrusive and resilient when switching apps, taking native photos, or recovering from tab crashes.

---

## GPS Jitter & Weak Signal UX

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Subtle amber status chip in HUD | Subtle amber status chip in HUD ('Weak GPS ±Xm') while quietly pausing breadcrumb recording until accuracy improves | ✓ |
| Persistent top notification banner | Persistent top notification banner explaining that GPS accuracy has dropped with troubleshooting hint | |
| Silent filtering | Quietly skip inaccurate points without disturbing user | |
| You decide | Weak GPS behavior | |

**User's choice:** Subtle amber status chip in HUD ('Weak GPS ±Xm') while quietly pausing breadcrumb recording until accuracy improves
**Notes:** Avoids polluting the polyline with noisy spikes (> 35m) while transparently signaling GPS quality.

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Don't append duplicate jitter points while stationary | Don't append duplicate jitter points to the trail polyline while stationary; maintain last known point and update active timestamp | ✓ |
| Append stationary heartbeat points | Append stationary heartbeat points every 15s to Dexie, but visually collapse them in the map polyline | |
| Strict displacement only | Never append any point unless displacement >= 5m | |
| You decide | Stationary stop point recording | |

**User's choice:** Don't append duplicate jitter points to the trail polyline while stationary; maintain last known point and update active timestamp
**Notes:** Prevents messy spiderweb loops on the trail when users stop to observe plants or snap pictures.

| Option | Description | Selected |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| Connect background gap continuously | Connect the background gap continuously to the new fix and recalculate cumulative distance via Haversine formula | ✓ |
| Distinct dashed line | Render the gap as a distinct dashed line labeled 'background segment' | |
| Prompt user on foreground return | Ask user if they want to stitch or split path | |
| You decide | Gap handling | |

| Option | Description | Selected |

| You decide | On-screen controls | |

**Notes:** Leaves user in control of whether to review past entries in Journal or prepare for another walk.

## Decisions Captured

### Walk Session UI & HUD Layout
- **D-01:** Full-screen MapLibre viewport with floating glassmorphism HUD pills (MM:SS timer, meters/km distance counter, GPS signal chip) and bottom floating action dock.
- **D-02:** Live metrics displayed in top HUD: elapsed duration (MM:SS), distance in meters/km, and GPS signal status chip (e.g., Live / Searching / Weak).
- **D-03:** Pre-walk landing state on `/walk` displays live interactive map centered on user location with floating bottom card ("Start Walk" button and walk mode badge).
- **D-04:** Seamless auto-restoration of active walk session upon reload/background return with a brief toast notification ("Active walk resumed") and camera fly-to latest GPS fix.

### GPS Jitter & Weak Signal UX
- **D-05:** Subtle amber status chip in HUD ("Weak GPS ±Xm") when accuracy degrades beyond 35m, quietly pausing breadcrumb recording until accuracy improves.
- **D-06:** Stationary stops (wildlife viewing/photo taking) do not append duplicate jitter points to the polyline; updates active timestamp while maintaining last known fix.
- **D-07:** Resuming from background throttling connects the gap continuously to the newly acquired GPS fix and recalculates distance via Haversine formula.
- **D-08:** GPS permission revocation or signal loss mid-walk keeps session active with an actionable top alert ("Re-enable Location" trigger) preserving prior points.

### Map Camera & Trail Navigation
- **D-09:** Camera auto-follows user location marker by default; user dragging pauses follow-mode and displays a floating "Recenter" button.
- **D-10:** Current location marker styled with Tangerin Dream terracotta/orange dot, subtle pulsing beacon ring, and heading arrow when device orientation is available.
- **D-11:** Breadcrumb trail rendered as a terracotta brand color polyline (4px width, rounded joints) accompanied by a subtle "Approximate path" micro-legend pill.
- **D-12:** Floating thumb-accessible control stack on the right edge: Recenter button, Zoom +/- buttons, and North compass reset.

### End Walk Flow & Summary Modal
- **D-13:** Hold-to-confirm button or 2-tap confirmation sheet guards against accidental walk termination while walking outdoors.
- **D-14:** Walk summary presented as a bottom drawer / modal sheet over the map with bounding-box fitted trail review and metrics grid (duration, distance, species count).
- **D-15:** Short/empty walks (< 1 minute or < 25 meters) prompt "Discard Walk" vs "Save Anyway" to prevent cluttering Dexie walk history.
- **D-16:** Primary "Done" action on summary card closes sheet and resets `/walk` back to the ready-to-start state, with a link to "View in Journal".
